study: Dickson to Red Deer 05CC002 historical observation adequacy
grid: UTC-aligned 300 s slots within the requested window; expected slots are an inferred denominator, not a claim of nominal station uptime.
joint_screen: Positive finite level and flow at all four river stations; a positive finite level at 05CC003 when required. Blank Symbol and Qualifiers fields, exact UTC five-minute keys, no imputation. Grade and approval retained.
strict_policy: Also require an explicit Final/Finales label on each value; other status and missing status excluded. No quality ordering of numeric grades assumed.

secondary_endpoint_only_approval_check.comparison: Endpoint discharge only, screened versus explicitly Final/Finales within UTC dates with any Final discharge.
secondary_endpoint_only_approval_check.decision_impact: Describes endpoint approval availability and cannot substitute for an all-final joint river/lake comparison.

lag_method: Pearson upstream Q(t-lag) versus endpoint Q(t); exact matches; common target support across tested lags within each upstream station; supports can differ between stations. Tested lags are illustrative, not a selected or verified transit time.
uncertainty: Percentile 95% intervals from 1000 resamples of fixed nonoverlapping 7-day UTC blocks (seed 20261120); at least 8 contributing blocks per cohort. P-S2 resamples paired calendar blocks and compares record-weighted means. Intervals describe historical sample variability, not independent-event, causal or forecast uncertainty.
limitations: Season, shared drivers, persistence and station-specific availability affect contemporaneous and lagged flow associations.
Receipt time does not prove availability at a historical forecast issue time.
Avoid interpreting a change in sample composition as a hydraulic effect of the lake.
Reported stage/elevation is not river-bed depth; common vertical datum and bank elevation not verified.
Rare highs cannot validate flood warnings. No CV inference, rainfall imputation, model performance, or site-level hazard is estimated.

sensitivity.comparison: Historical lake-complete screen versus same screen requiring explicit Final/Finales for all nine values.
sensitivity.decision_impact: No joint all-final estimate available; retain flagged historical observations only for exploratory use.

sensitivity.comparison: River-only versus lake-complete using the historical screen on the same UTC dates that have at least one lake-complete candidate.
sensitivity.decision_impact: Show lake-complete estimates as conditional on lake availability; do not impute or require lake data for a river-only descriptive analysis.

disposition: Experimental descriptive study only; operational use withheld.
